decisions.reason: The area elastic sports flooring builds directly on the firm's wood-surface know-how and in-house R&D, so management can interpret results and refine the line.
The mobile arena floor system draws on the firm's established sports flooring expertise, which lets it absorb market feedback, though overlap with a similar system adds some risk of consolidation.
This second mobile arena system also builds on existing related knowledge, although it may be merged with the parallel system in a rationalised range.
The chevron parquet is close to the core offer and a flagship of the trend-led residential direction, so the firm's knowledge base strongly supports keeping it.
The squash court surface finish uses the firm's surface-treatment know-how, so it is easy to assimilate and maintain at low cost.
The oak skirting is a simple accessory built on existing wood processing capabilities that complements the sports floor systems.
